claims.title: Naqada cultures flourish in Upper Egypt
claims.summary: Predynastic settlements in Upper Egypt develop social hierarchy, craft specialisation and long-distance trade, laying the groundwork for state formation.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Egypt: Five millennia of civilisation along the Nile, from the first pharaohs to the modern Arab republic.", terralore.co/country/EGY/chronicle#ev-3500bce-naqada-cultures-flourish-in-upper-egypt, claim TL:EGY:event:3500bce:naqada-cultures-flourish-in-upper-egypt, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Unification under Narmer (Menes)
claims.summary: Upper and Lower Egypt are united into a single kingdom under King Narmer, traditionally identified with Menes, inaugurating the First Dynasty and the dynastic state.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Egypt: Five millennia of civilisation along the Nile, from the first pharaohs to the modern Arab republic.", terralore.co/country/EGY/chronicle#ev-3100bce-unification-under-narmer-menes, claim TL:EGY:event:3100bce:unification-under-narmer-menes, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Memphis founded as royal capital
claims.summary: A new capital is established at Memphis near the meeting point of the Two Lands, becoming the administrative heart of early pharaonic Egypt.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Egypt: Five millennia of civilisation along the Nile, from the first pharaohs to the modern Arab republic.", terralore.co/country/EGY/chronicle#ev-3100bce-memphis-founded-as-royal-capital, claim TL:EGY:event:3100bce:memphis-founded-as-royal-capital, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Djoser's Step Pyramid at Saqqara
claims.summary: Imhotep designs the Step Pyramid for King Djoser, the first monumental stone structure in Egypt and a prototype for the pyramids to come.

claims.title: Great Pyramid of Khufu at Giza
claims.summary: King Khufu raises the Great Pyramid at Giza, the largest of the pyramids and the sole surviving wonder of the ancient world.

claims.title: Mentuhotep II reunifies Egypt
claims.summary: Mentuhotep II of Thebes defeats the rival Heracleopolitan kings and reunites Egypt, inaugurating the Middle Kingdom.

sources.label: Ancient Egypt: The Old Kingdom and the First Intermediate Period

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Egypt: Five millennia of civilisation along the Nile, from the first pharaohs to the modern Arab republic.", terralore.co/country/EGY/chronicle#ev-2055bce-mentuhotep-ii-reunifies-egypt, claim TL:EGY:event:2055bce:mentuhotep-ii-reunifies-egypt, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Battle of Kadesh
claims.summary: Ramses II confronts the Hittites at Kadesh in Syria; the ensuing accord is among the earliest documented peace treaties.

sources.label: Ancient Egypt: The Old Kingdom and the First Intermediate Period

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Egypt: Five millennia of civilisation along the Nile, from the first pharaohs to the modern Arab republic.", terralore.co/country/EGY/chronicle#ev-1274bce-battle-of-kadesh, claim TL:EGY:event:1274bce:battle-of-kadesh, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Tutankhamun restores the old gods
claims.summary: The young Tutankhamun reverses Akhenaten's Aten cult and restores traditional Egyptian religion; his intact tomb, found in 1922, made him world-famous.

sources.label: Ancient Egypt: The Old Kingdom and the First Intermediate Period

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Egypt: Five millennia of civilisation along the Nile, from the first pharaohs to the modern Arab republic.", terralore.co/country/EGY/chronicle#ev-1336bce-tutankhamun-restores-the-old-gods, claim TL:EGY:event:1336bce:tutankhamun-restores-the-old-gods, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Alexander the Great conquers Egypt
claims.summary: Alexander expels Persian rule, is hailed as pharaoh and founds Alexandria, opening the Hellenistic age in Egypt.

sources.label: Ancient Egypt: The Old Kingdom and the First Intermediate Period

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Egypt: Five millennia of civilisation along the Nile, from the first pharaohs to the modern Arab republic.", terralore.co/country/EGY/chronicle#ev-332bce-alexander-the-great-conquers-egypt, claim TL:EGY:event:332bce:alexander-the-great-conquers-egypt, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Ptolemy I founds the Ptolemaic dynasty
claims.summary: Alexander's general Ptolemy takes the royal title in Egypt, founding a Macedonian dynasty that rules from Alexandria for nearly three centuries.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Egypt: Five millennia of civilisation along the Nile, from the first pharaohs to the modern Arab republic.", terralore.co/country/EGY/chronicle#ev-305bce-ptolemy-i-founds-the-ptolemaic-dynasty, claim TL:EGY:event:305bce:ptolemy-i-founds-the-ptolemaic-dynasty, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Rome annexes Egypt
claims.summary: After Cleopatra VII and Mark Antony are defeated at Actium, Octavian annexes Egypt as a Roman province, ending the Ptolemaic dynasty.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Egypt: Five millennia of civilisation along the Nile, from the first pharaohs to the modern Arab republic.", terralore.co/country/EGY/chronicle#ev-30bce-rome-annexes-egypt, claim TL:EGY:event:30bce:rome-annexes-egypt, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Council of Chalcedon and the Coptic schism
claims.summary: Doctrinal disputes over the nature of Christ separate the Egyptian (Coptic) Church from the imperial church of Constantinople.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Egypt: Five millennia of civilisation along the Nile, from the first pharaohs to the modern Arab republic.", terralore.co/country/EGY/chronicle#ev-451-council-of-chalcedon-and-the-coptic-schism, claim TL:EGY:event:451:council-of-chalcedon-and-the-coptic-schism, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Arab conquest of Egypt
claims.summary: Amr ibn al-As leads the Muslim conquest of Byzantine Egypt and founds Fustat, beginning the country's transformation into a Muslim land.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Egypt: Five millennia of civilisation along the Nile, from the first pharaohs to the modern Arab republic.", terralore.co/country/EGY/chronicle#ev-639-arab-conquest-of-egypt, claim TL:EGY:event:639:arab-conquest-of-egypt, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Fatimids conquer Egypt and found Cairo
claims.summary: The Fatimid general Jawhar conquers Egypt and founds al-Qahira (Cairo); the al-Azhar mosque, begun in 970, becomes a great seat of learning.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Egypt: Five millennia of civilisation along the Nile, from the first pharaohs to the modern Arab republic.", terralore.co/country/EGY/chronicle#ev-969-fatimids-conquer-egypt-and-found-cairo, claim TL:EGY:event:969:fatimids-conquer-egypt-and-found-cairo, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Saladin founds the Ayyubid dynasty
claims.summary: Saladin abolishes the Fatimid caliphate, restores Sunni rule in Egypt and establishes the Ayyubid dynasty, later retaking Jerusalem in 1187.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Egypt: Five millennia of civilisation along the Nile, from the first pharaohs to the modern Arab republic.", terralore.co/country/EGY/chronicle#ev-1171-saladin-founds-the-ayyubid-dynasty, claim TL:EGY:event:1171:saladin-founds-the-ayyubid-dynasty, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Mamluks seize power
claims.summary: The slave-soldier Mamluks overthrow the last Ayyubid ruler and establish a sultanate that will govern Egypt and Syria for over two and a half centuries.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Egypt: Five millennia of civilisation along the Nile, from the first pharaohs to the modern Arab republic.", terralore.co/country/EGY/chronicle#ev-1250-mamluks-seize-power, claim TL:EGY:event:1250:mamluks-seize-power, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Battle of Ain Jalut
claims.summary: Mamluk forces defeat the Mongols at Ain Jalut in Palestine, halting their westward advance and securing Egypt as the bastion of the Islamic world.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Egypt: Five millennia of civilisation along the Nile, from the first pharaohs to the modern Arab republic.", terralore.co/country/EGY/chronicle#ev-1260-battle-of-ain-jalut, claim TL:EGY:event:1260:battle-of-ain-jalut, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Ottoman conquest of Egypt
claims.summary: Selim I defeats the Mamluks and incorporates Egypt into the Ottoman Empire as a province governed from Istanbul.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Egypt: Five millennia of civilisation along the Nile, from the first pharaohs to the modern Arab republic.", terralore.co/country/EGY/chronicle#ev-1517-ottoman-conquest-of-egypt, claim TL:EGY:event:1517:ottoman-conquest-of-egypt, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Muhammad Ali takes power
claims.summary: Recognised as Ottoman governor, Muhammad Ali founds a reforming dynasty and modernises Egypt's army, economy and administration.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Egypt: Five millennia of civilisation along the Nile, from the first pharaohs to the modern Arab republic.", terralore.co/country/EGY/chronicle#ev-1805-muhammad-ali-takes-power, claim TL:EGY:event:1805:muhammad-ali-takes-power, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Opening of the Suez Canal
claims.summary: The Suez Canal links the Mediterranean and Red seas, transforming global trade but deepening Egypt's debts to European powers.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Egypt: Five millennia of civilisation along the Nile, from the first pharaohs to the modern Arab republic.", terralore.co/country/EGY/chronicle#ev-1869-opening-of-the-suez-canal, claim TL:EGY:event:1869:opening-of-the-suez-canal, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: British occupation begins
claims.summary: Britain defeats the Urabi revolt and occupies Egypt, taking effective control of the country while leaving the khedive nominally in place.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Egypt: Five millennia of civilisation along the Nile, from the first pharaohs to the modern Arab republic.", terralore.co/country/EGY/chronicle#ev-1882-british-occupation-begins, claim TL:EGY:event:1882:british-occupation-begins, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Declaration of Egyptian independence
claims.summary: After the 1919 revolution led by Saad Zaghloul and the Wafd, Britain unilaterally declares Egypt independent; Fuad I becomes king of the new Kingdom of Egypt.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Egypt: Five millennia of civilisation along the Nile, from the first pharaohs to the modern Arab republic.", terralore.co/country/EGY/chronicle#ev-1922-declaration-of-egyptian-independence, claim TL:EGY:event:1922:declaration-of-egyptian-independence, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Free Officers' revolution
claims.summary: A coup by the Free Officers overthrows King Farouk, ending the Muhammad Ali dynasty's effective rule and beginning the republican era.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Egypt: Five millennia of civilisation along the Nile, from the first pharaohs to the modern Arab republic.", terralore.co/country/EGY/chronicle#ev-1952-free-officers-revolution, claim TL:EGY:event:1952:free-officers-revolution, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Republic of Egypt proclaimed
claims.summary: The monarchy is formally abolished and Egypt is declared a republic, with Muhammad Naguib as its first president.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Egypt: Five millennia of civilisation along the Nile, from the first pharaohs to the modern Arab republic.", terralore.co/country/EGY/chronicle#ev-1953-republic-of-egypt-proclaimed, claim TL:EGY:event:1953:republic-of-egypt-proclaimed, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Suez Crisis
claims.summary: Nasser nationalises the Suez Canal; an invasion by Britain, France and Israel is forced into withdrawal, confirming Egypt's sovereignty and Nasser's standing.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Egypt: Five millennia of civilisation along the Nile, from the first pharaohs to the modern Arab republic.", terralore.co/country/EGY/chronicle#ev-1956-suez-crisis, claim TL:EGY:event:1956:suez-crisis, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Egypt–Israel peace treaty
claims.summary: Following the 1978 Camp David Accords, Sadat signs a peace treaty with Israel, the first between Israel and an Arab state, returning the Sinai to Egypt.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Egypt: Five millennia of civilisation along the Nile, from the first pharaohs to the modern Arab republic.", terralore.co/country/EGY/chronicle#ev-1979-egypt-israel-peace-treaty, claim TL:EGY:event:1979:egypt-israel-peace-treaty, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Egyptian revolution and Mubarak's fall
claims.summary: Mass protests from 25 January force President Hosni Mubarak to resign on 11 February after nearly thirty years in power.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Egypt: Five millennia of civilisation along the Nile, from the first pharaohs to the modern Arab republic.", terralore.co/country/EGY/chronicle#ev-2011-egyptian-revolution-and-mubarak-s-fall, claim TL:EGY:event:2011:egyptian-revolution-and-mubarak-s-fall, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.
